# Ivan Alexandrov

> Ivan Alexandrov is an AI product and frontend engineer working remotely from Chișinău, Moldova, with 8+ years of TypeScript and React. He builds web products in React and Next.js for clients, and his own multi-agent harness on Claude Code that takes a roadmap step from plan to merged pull request.

Open to remote AI product engineer and senior frontend roles (EET, UTC+2/+3).
